arxiv-2411-05941.creator: Kathrin Bringmann, Guoniu Han, Bernhard Heim, Ben Kane
arxiv-2411-05941.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study vanishing of Fourier coefficients of holomorphic η \eta -quotients. arxiv-2510-25132.title: EnzyControl: Adding Functional and Substrate-Specific Control for Enzyme Backbone Generation
arxiv-2510-25132.creator: Chao Song, Zhiyuan Liu, Han Huang, Liang Wang, Qiong Wang, Jianyu Shi, Hui Yu, Yihang Zhou, Yang Zhang
arxiv-2510-25132.description: Abstract Designing enzyme backbones with substrate-specific functionality is a critical challenge in computational protein engineering. Current generative models excel in protein design but face limitations in binding data, substrate-specific control, and flexibility for de novo enzyme backbone generation. To address this, we introduce EnzyBind , a dataset with 11,100 experimentally validated enzyme-substrate pairs specifically curated from PDBbind.

pmc-12680827.title: Incomplete Right Bundle Branch Block: A Narrative Review of Clinical Relevance, Diagnostic Pitfalls, and Prognostic Implications
pmc-12680827.creator: Jozef Dodulík, Jiří Plášek, Jiří Vrtal, Jan Václavík
pmc-12680827.description: IntroductionIncomplete right bundle branch block (iRBBB) is a frequent electrocardiographic (ECG) finding, often considered benign. However, recent evidence suggests it may be associated with underlying structural or electrical abnormalities, particularly in selected populations.MethodsWe conducted a narrative review of population-based cohorts, mechanistic studies, and clinical trials focused on the prevalence, pathophysiological mechanisms, differential diagnosis, and prognostic implications of iRBBB.

pmc-12722240.description: Infant rice cereal (IRC), presents an increasing risk of allergic reactions upon initial exposure, effective assessment models remain underdeveloped.
